Welcome to SUPER SOLDIER TRAINING LAB!
Where you become useful beans and help you do your solemn duty!
Just do as I say and follow the crash course.
This is the first tutorial course so if you are smarter than squirrels. There would be no problem!
(Unknown cheering sounds)
Sigh... Let’s hope you’re more competent than the last batch.
But remember both of you need to cross. So use your airgun creatively.
Good, If you activate the bean pipe, consider that as a checkpoint for the course.
If your dumb partner is dead, We will slide another one of the clones through the pipe right away.
This is the second tutorial course. It seems you two were smarter than average beans.
This is the third and the last tutorial course. Most beans aren't getting this far, so congrats.
Maybe you think this tutorials are too easy.
But remember, most beans can't even open the peanut butter jar.
Congrats on finishing all three tutorial.
Finally we can do some real tests.
Time to practice the basics of the movement here.
You’ve probably already messed around with it on the way here—but I’ll explain it anyway.
Operate it as shown on the wall. Hook it onto surfaces and adjust the length as needed.
Once hooked, you can swing side to side to reach farther. Use it wisely.
Oh, and by the way—that blue barrier you passed? It disintegrates everything that isn't you or your tools.
Can’t have you sneaking junk out of here, can we?
(Nods approvingly)
Now, Time to practice the basics of the air gun.
Given how sluggish you are, you’ll probably need it more than most.
Use the air gun as shown. Suck things in, then shoot them out.
With your air gun, You can even suck in your partner—if they’re hooked onto something, you’ll get pulled to them.
And while you’re latched on, firing the air gun will propel you—use that to get over obstacles.
See that multi-purpose drone flying overhead?
If you hit what it’s carrying with the air gun propelled objects, it’ll drop it.
Go on, give it a try.
Now it’s time to use both of your tools to clear a basic obstacle.
Based on your Bean University scores, this should be a cakewalk.
Since you passed the obstacle, you’re now entering the zone where most test subjects tend to fail.
It’s... the ultra-simple puzzle.
Let’s hope your head doesn’t explode from thinking too hard.
Miraculous. Test subjects with functioning brains—haven’t seen that in ages.
Go on, grab the key and get moving.
Now we’re moving on to a course that covers a wider range of items.
Nothing too complicated—but definitely more dangerous.
This is the final part of the training course, so try not to embarrass yourself.
That red barrier up ahead? It disintegrates organic material.
Kind of the opposite of the blue one you saw earlier. So… yeah, don’t touch it.
...Wait, what? Where did you go? No signal, no camera feed, just—
(Static noise)
What? Where the hell did you pop out from?!
I was this close to writing you off as a failed test and having you scrapped.
No idea what happened, but hey, you’re back. So let’s just finish the course, shall we?
Nice work. That wraps up the whole—
...Oh. Right. I forgot to place the key.
Well, I’ll just toss it behind the teleporter or something. Go grab it.
Now that you've got the basics down, I’ve prepared a course to practice with some objects.
This one’s mainly about lasers—so maybe don’t go poking around unless you’re into spontaneous combustion.
Honestly, I can’t even remember the last time this course was used. Most test beans don’t make it past the first one.
Anyway, let’s get started.
...You didn’t already die on your way here, did you?
Up ahead, you'll find a variety of laser-reflecting gadgets.
Reflective boxes you can carry around, and adjustable mirrors you can rotate.
Use them wisely and try not to vaporize yourself. Good luck.
Now, there's a simple balloon puzzle up ahead.
You’ll find inflatable balloons—and if there are balloons, that means there are numbered energy orbs scattered around.
There should also be receivers on the walls to hold those orbs, each labeled with a number in a order.
Your job is simple: match the orbs to the receivers in the correct sequence.
Then, just puff up the balloon with the air gun, and voilà—puzzle solved.
This used to be a multi-step deduction puzzle, but...
let’s just say none of the tiny-brained test subjects could figure it out. So we dumbed it down.
Wow. You actually cleared this course too? You might just be in the top 0.1% of test subjects.
Please, Look forward to the official release!

24 hours of operation. Zero strikes.
Zero coffee breaks.
Faster, and far less complaining.

Protecting your assets takes technology—
not emotions.
Lasers resolve disputes faster than lawyers.

Precision Environmental Maintenance Unit.
Humanity’s progress halts
at unmanaged power cables.
Alright, now that you've learned all the basics, it's time to start the final test course.
I hope you succeed this time, unlike the ones before you.
Took you long enough. But at least you made it through the course, so that’s something.
Well done. You did bring the key, right?
How much easier do I need to make this? This is tiring.
Hm. I didn’t expect failure here.
You don’t just enjoy popping balloons, do you?
[Horrifying!] But worry not! With the cutting-edge technology of our super lab, we can reproduce as many times as needed!
They sure do die a lot! That one is on their [/1st] reproduction now.
What, dead again? I expected a lot of deaths, but this is already their [/1st] time.
Ah, they died. What number was it again…? Oh right, [/1st]!
You behave as if remaking you costs nothing.
Surely it isn’t just because you’re too lazy. Life shouldn’t be given up that easily, you know.
Watching explosions was amusing at first. Now it’s getting dull.
Smell that? Someone’s grilling sausages.
Oh wow, you’re really on fire.
Hahaha! …Oh, whoops, you died.
All the cameras are flashing now.
Does it sting?
Hey, careful not to short-circuit.
